content.text: seek not after your own heart, Num. 15:39. seek ye the priesthood also, Num. 16:10. thou shalt seek the Lord thy God, Deut. 4:29. Lord hath sought him a man after his own heart, 1 Sam. 13:14. they seek my life, 1 Kgs. 19:10 (Rom. 11:3). Seek the Lord and his strength, 1 Chr. 16:11 (Ps. 105:4). if thou seek him, he will be found, 1 Chr. 28:9. Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the Lord, Ezra 7:10. God is upon all them for good that seek him, Ezra 8:22. any that did understand, and seek God, Ps. 14:2 (53:2). Thy face, Lord, will I seek, Ps. 27:8. seek peace, and pursue it, Ps. 34:14 (1 Pet. 3:11). my God; early will I seek thee, Ps. 63:1. your heart shall live that seek God, Ps. 69:32. Blessed are they … that seek him with the whole heart, Ps. 119:2. they shall seek me early, Prov. 1:28. those that seek me early shall find me, Prov. 8:17 (D&C 88:83). he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him, Prov. 11:27. root of Jesse … to it shall the Gentiles seek, Isa. 11:10 (2 Ne. 21:10). with my spirit … will I seek thee early, Isa. 26:9. Seek ye out of the book of the Lord, Isa. 34:16. Seek ye the Lord while he may be found, Isa. 55:6. they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways, Isa. 58:2. am found of them that sought me not, Isa. 65:1 (Rom. 10:20). pastors … have not sought the Lord, Jer. 10:21. ye shall seek me, and find me, Jer. 29:13. seekest thou great things for thyself? seek them not, Jer. 45:5. Lord is good … to the soul that seeketh him, Lam. 3:25. they shall seek peace, and there shall be none, Ezek. 7:25. As a shepherd … will I seek out my sheep, Ezek. 34:12. I will seek that which was lost, Ezek. 34:16. I set my face unto the Lord God, to seek by prayer, Dan. 9:3. Israel return, and seek the Lord, Hosea 3:5. in their affliction they will seek me early, Hosea 5:15. Seek ye me, and ye shall live, Amos 5:4. Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live, Amos 5:14. they shall run to and fro to seek the word of the Lord, Amos 8:12.

seek ye first the kingdom of God, Matt. 6:33 (Luke 12:31; 3 Ne. 13:33; D&C 11:23). seek, and ye shall find, Matt. 7:7 (Luke 11:9). he that seeketh findeth, Matt. 7:8 (1 Ne. 10:19; 3 Ne. 14:8). An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign, Matt. 12:39 (16:4; Mark 8:12; Luke 11:29). leave the ninety and nine … and seeketh that which is gone astray, Matt. 18:12. all the council, sought false witness against Jesus, Matt. 26:59 (Mark 14:55). chief priests … sought how they might destroy him, Mark 11:18 (Luke 19:47). chief priests … sought how they might take him by craft, Mark 14:1. thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing, Luke 2:48. three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, Luke 13:7. many … will seek to enter in, and shall not be able, Luke 13:24. sweep the house, and seek diligently, Luke 15:8. Why seek ye the living among the dead, Luke 24:5. Jesus … saith unto them, What seek ye, John 1:38. I seek not mine own will, John 5:30. Ye seek me … because ye did eat of the loaves, John 6:26. Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me, John 7:34. ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins, John 8:21. I seek not mine own glory, John 8:50. Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou, John 20:15. That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, Acts 15:17. That they should seek the Lord, Acts 17:27. To them who … seek for glory and honour and immortality, Rom. 2:7. Greeks seek after wisdom, 1 Cor. 1:22. Let no man seek his own, but every man another’s wealth, 1 Cor. 10:24. not seeking mine own profit, but the profit of many, 1 Cor. 10:33. seeketh not her own, 1 Cor. 13:5 (Moro. 7:45). seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church, 1 Cor. 14:12. I seek not yours, but you, 2 Cor. 12:14. all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ’s, Philip. 2:21. seek those things which are above, Col. 3:1. rewarder of them that diligently seek him, Heb. 11:6. declare plainly that they seek a country, Heb. 11:14. no continuing city, but we seek one to come, Heb. 13:14. in those days shall men seek death, Rev. 9:6.

blessed are they who shall seek to bring forth my Zion, 1 Ne. 13:37. he seeketh that all men might be miserable, 2 Ne. 2:27. wo unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel, 2 Ne. 27:27. before ye seek for riches, seek ye for the kingdom, Jacob 2:18. seek not to counsel the Lord, Jacob 4:10 (D&C 22:4). Alma … seek to destroy the church no more, Mosiah 27:16 (Alma 36:9). Seek not after riches … you cannot carry them with you, Alma 39:14. I seek not for honor of the world, Alma 60:36.

They seek not the Lord, D&C 1:16. Seek not for riches but for wisdom, D&C 6:7 (11:7). Seek not to declare my word, but first seek to obtain my word, D&C 11:21. land of your inheritance, if you seek it with all your hearts, D&C 38:19. seek ye earnestly the best gifts, D&C 46:8. given for the benefit of those … that seek, D&C 46:9. he that seeketh signs shall see signs, but not unto salvation, D&C 63:7. they also seek not earnestly the riches of eternity, D&C 68:31. Every man seeking the interest of his neighbor, D&C 82:19. That which … seeketh to become a law unto itself, D&C 88:35. seek me diligently and ye shall find me, D&C 88:63. seek ye diligently and teach one another, D&C 88:118 (109:7). seek the face of the Lord always, D&C 101:38. holy calling, which I now give unto him, seeking diligently the kingdom, D&C 106:3. Satan seeketh to destroy, D&C 132:57.
